def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_cut = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and 3 <= i <= h-4), None)
    if row_cut is not None:
        a, b = grid[:row_cut], grid[row_cut+1:]
    else:
        col_cut = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1)
        a = [row[:col_cut] for row in grid]
        b = [row[col_cut+1:] for row in grid]
    ca, cb = set(v for row in a for v in row), set(v for row in b for v in row)
    common = next(iter(ca & cb))
    return [[3 if x == common and y == common else common for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
